en.title: Daily Accessibility Digest: Key Developments on May 15, 2026
en.summary: Today's highlights include government pledges to accelerate disability inclusion laws, GAAD's focus on home support for older adults, vision models enabling scalable accessibility testing, and Kenya's awards recognizing accessibility champions.

highlights.title: Government pledges to speed disability inclusion laws
GAAD highlights home support for older adults
Vision Models Enable Scalable Accessibility Testing
Kenya Disability Inclusion Awards Recognize Accessibility Champions
